notes: This is the standalone/BYOD "Jabra PanaCast 50" panoramic 4K video bar (model VSM020, SKUs 8200-232 Black / 8201-232 Grey) — distinct from the "PanaCast 50 Video Bar System (VBS)" and "PanaCast 50 Room System," which are separate bundled products with additional HDMI in/out ports on a companion compute unit, not on the PanaCast 50 camera bar itself. Physical ports confirmed from Jabra's official User Manual port diagram (labels: AC power, AUXIN, ETHERNET, USB-C, plus non-connector Reset and Bluetooth-pair buttons) and official Tech Sheets (2021 RevB and 2024/2025 revision). USB-A appears in the tech-sheet "Connectivity" line only because Jabra bundles a USB-C-to-USB-A cable for host-side connection to computers without USB-C — the device itself has a single USB-C port, not a separate USB-A port, so USB-A was not added as a distinct physical port. Ethernet port speed (10/100/1000) is not explicitly stated in the standalone PanaCast 50 tech sheets (unlike the related VBS spec sheet which does state 10/100/1000), so the eth grade was omitted rather than assumed. Power is an external brick (barrel connector at the device) — exact DC voltage/current of the barrel jack is not published by Jabra; represented as dc-barrel per the port-list guidance for "external DC adapter." Aux is labeled "AUXIN" in the device diagram but described as "Aux-Out" in the connectivity spec line in some tech-sheet revisions; functionally it is a 3.5mm analog jack used mainly for auxiliary audio, so direction is set to input per the physical silkscreen label (AUXIN) while noting the ambiguity.

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: Host connection to computer; supports USB 2.0 and USB 3.0 (SuperSpeed 5Gbps) per Jabra spec

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: RJ45 for connection to Jabra Xpress and other management systems; link speed not stated in official PanaCast 50 spec sheets

ports.name: AUXIN
ports.note: 3.5mm auxiliary audio jack; labeled AUXIN on device diagram, referred to as "Aux-Out" in some tech-sheet connectivity lines

ports.name: Power
ports.note: DC input from included external power supply/adapter (AC-to-DC brick); exact DC voltage/current not published
